'''Ellis Kwok''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[May 2001 Vancouver tournament]] on 20 May 2001 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Abyssin Court weird thing]] and [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base X-wings flip]], according to Cole Roche's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2355">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-22-vancouver-british-columbia-20-5-01d2355/ vancouver-british-columbia-20-5-01], DeckTech (Cole "Rabid Wookie" Roche, 22 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-22-vancouver-british-columbia-20-5-01d2355/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
